correctness.rationale: Inspected arbitrary fixed convex polytopes P⊂R^d, d≥2. Strict norm convexity forces all diametral pairs to be vertices, and positive axial derivatives on nonzero inward cone directions give uniform localization. On each simplicial cone pair exactly ||Y−X||²=(D−Σt_j)²+||Σt_j c_j||²; implicit expansion of radial cutoff and Dirichlet(1,...,1) moments yield A_P=ΣJ/[V²(2d)!] and B_P=ΣJQ/[2DV²(2d+1)!], O_P(ε^(2d+2)), both positive. Independent direct linear-algebra check of Q for rectangle, cube and unequal 2/3-dimensional boxes matches orthotope formula and AM–GM gives cube-only equality at fixed V. Numeric finite checks support, not replace, arbitrary-polytope proof.

value.rationale: Explicit universal two-term diameter-tail invariants of arbitrary fixed convex polytopes in terms of geometric vertex tangent cones, including a rigorous next-order correction and sharp box extremizers. This fills a natural endpoint asymptotic beyond leading sample-diameter laws.

final_claim: For all fixed full-dimensional convex polytopes, two-term ε^(2d)+ε^(2d+1) ordered-diametral-cone expansion; box formula and cube-only leading minimizer at fixed volume.
limitations: For each fixed polytope the expansion is asymptotic, not uniform over degenerating families; no smooth-body or boundary-sampling result.
Earlier cube tail orders are known; older integral geometry could have an equivalent all-cone second-order expansion.
